The association of 2756 A>G of methionine synthase (MTR), 66 A>G of methionine synthase reductase (MTRR) and 776 C>G of transcobalamin (TCN2) needs to be evaluated further.
It was the objective of this study to evaluate the association of these polymorphisms, t-Hcys, vitamin B12 and folate levels with iCVD, in an Italian population from Sicily.

No association was found between MTHFR, MTR, MTRR and TCN2 polymorphisms and iCVD risk.
We have found an influence of t-Hcys and a neutral effect of MTHFR, MTR, MTRR and TCN2 on iCVD risk in Sicily.
The neutral influence of these polymorphisms may be explained by adequate status in folate and vitamin B12.
Other factors underlying the increased t-Hcys need further investigations.
